newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil futures end firm after bumpy ride.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil futures end firm after bumpy ride.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures ended firm on Thursday, retaining most of their morning gains made on the back of cold weather in Europe and forecasts of deteriorating weather conditions in the U.S., brokers said.
Crude and products futures on both sides of the Atlantic had a bumpy ride with sharp losses on gasoline spurring bouts of profit taking in otherwise well supported crude and heating oil markets.
January gas oil ,which expires on Friday, last traded $3.50 up at $234 a tonne in mid-range after hitting $235.25 on early buying and dipping to $232.75 on profit taking.
Brent futures were also staging a recovering in late trade with the February contract up nine cents at $24.89 it's highest level so far today.
Trendline resistance is pegged at $24.90 and after this the next resistance level is seen at $25.06 a barrel a six year high.
